purpose: Illustrative promotional mockups with fictional demo content; not actual application screenshots.

images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished landscape 16:9 promotional mockup image for the existing Windows desktop app DoubleSlash. Target 1920x1080. It is an illustrative preview, not an actual screenshot. Show a plausible, carefully typeset fictional demo of the actual app's private messaging layout. Do not invent features.
Design: entirely angular desktop UI, square corners on all windows, buttons, avatars, chat bubbles and badges; absolutely no circles, rounded rectangles or pill controls. Default app palette: near-black title bar #111214, charcoal background #1E1F22, sidebar #2B2D31, raised tiles #383A40, text #DCDDDE, muted #A6A9B0, selection accent #5865F2, green #3BA55D and brand red #FF2B40. Modern clear sans serif typography and crisp thin SVG-like line icons. Branding is DoubleSlash with a bold geometric red D:// mark. No other brand logos.
Composition: a restrained dark promotional canvas, large heading "Invite-only chat" above one large straight-on, flat desktop application window taking most of the frame; small DoubleSlash branding. The app must look functional and legible, with plenty of whitespace in the conversation.
App title bar: red D:// mark at top left, an elongated angular hexagonal "Peers | Rooms" toggle immediately beside it with Peers selected. Square window controls top right.
Left sidebar: "Message myself" pinned first, then "Peers" heading with a plus square button and fictional contacts "Alex", "Morgan", "Sam", "Riley". Square geometric identicons. Alex selected. Small rectangular status "Connected".
Main chat: header "Alex", small green square status and square call and file buttons. Demo messages: Alex: "Ready to share the project files?" You: "Yes. Sending the latest draft now." Alex: "Got it. Let's talk it through." A square attachment card "Project notes.pdf" with label "Download". Bottom message field "Message Alex" and a square send icon. No live invite URLs, private keys, peer IDs or actual personal data. No network-wide discovery, contact directory, claim of zero metadata, public feed, identity cloud login, or AI-generated chat replies.
Put a small but legible caption outside the app window along the lower edge: "Illustrative preview • Demo content". No extra slogans, no exaggerated security claims, no device photograph, no 3D perspective, no gradients or decorative neon. Excellent typography and visual hierarchy; all copy in English.
images.refinement_prompt: Edit this DoubleSlash promotional chat mockup. Preserve every word, all demo messages, identities, attachment, layout, colors, spacing, overall dimensions, branding, and the footer "Illustrative preview • Demo content". Make one precise styling correction: make the interface fully flat and square-edged. Remove corner rounding from all chat message rectangles, attachment card, contact selection, buttons, avatars, status badges and app window. All those corners must be exact 90 degree corners with zero border radius. Preserve the pointed angular hexagonal Peers/Rooms toggle. Remove glossy or metallic shading and gradient fills from the app surfaces; use solid charcoal and solid blue fills with crisp 1px borders. Do not add or remove controls, change typography, change copy or shift anything. Return one polished image.

Rooms is selected in the title bar. Left sidebar heading Rooms, with a plus square icon. Display the fictional node "Community node" and a nested room tree. Sub-rooms "Design" and "Workshop" appear below that room's leaves and remain inside the tree. Other sibling room "Lounge" below. Membership is IN THE LEFT TREE, never in a right-hand rail.
At foot of sidebar, a persistent dark square-edged VoiceDock: "Studio", "Connected", time "08:24", square microphone, video and screen controls and a red "Leave" tile.

Bottom input "Message Studio" and a square send button. Make room hierarchy and separate voice/text membership extremely clear and legible. Keep abundant visual breathing room.
